reviews.text: this is a good quality cleanser, love it . it’s gentle and effective, I recommend it
reviews.zh: 呢款潔面產品質素好好，我好鍾意。佢溫和又有效，我推薦。

reviews.text: no irrita para nada la piel y no te deja ningún tipo de sensación de tirantez
reviews.zh: 完全唔會刺激皮膚，亦唔會令皮膚有任何緊繃感。

reviews.text: Me encanta este jabon, es super suave para la piel y emulsiona bastante
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款潔面皂，對皮膚超級溫和，打泡效果都好好。

reviews.text: ive used this for 2 weeks now and my skin hasnt felt super dry or irritated. it hasnt broke me out either. cant rlly find anything bad abt this product so its currently my main cleanser
reviews.zh: 我用咗呢款兩個星期，皮膚冇覺得好乾或者刺激。亦都冇令我爆痘。我真係搵唔到呢款產品有咩唔好，所以而家係我嘅主要潔面產品。

reviews.text: first day of using and its noticeably less stripping than my last cleanser (round lab 1025). i woke up and my t zone is much less oily than usual. might update in a week if i remember to
reviews.zh: 第一日用，明顯冇咁會洗走油分，比我之前嗰款潔面產品（round lab 1025）溫和。我起身嗰陣，T 區出油明顯比平時少好多。如果記得嘅話，一個星期後可能會再更新。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
